_readme: T96's costume prompts. gen.py builds each candidate prompt as style + subject + ref_suffix, and the negative as negative + the costume's extra_negative.

style, ref_suffix and the start of negative are the style guide's lines (Docs/Art/Direction/README.md), word for word; T96 adds 'Shown on its own, worn by no one.' to ref_suffix and head and character words to negative.
Each costume is drawn in one of its roles' colors (color_role). The model is one color, tinted per role by M_Clay (T47), so the drawn color only has to read well.
drop: words taken out of the negative for that costume (the wig and the beard are sculpted hair, as one solid mass).
extra_negative: words added to the negative for that costume. subject_round1: the subject before a redraw.
style: Stop-motion claymation style: hand-sculpted from matte modeling clay with faint thumbprints, soft rounded chunky forms, bold simple shapes and a clean readable silhouette, saturated slightly chalky colors, from the same world as a gold, crimson and cream 19th-century clay opera house.
ref_suffix: Shown on its own, worn by no one. Single object, centered, three-quarter front view, whole object in frame, plain light gray background, soft even studio light, no cast shadow, no text, no logos.
negative: text, letters, words, logo, watermark, brand mark, realistic human face, hair, fur, thin wires, glossy plastic, chrome, photorealistic, ink outlines, flat 2D illustration, scary, gore, extra characters, head, face, mannequin, person, robot, character, body, glow, transparent, reflections, multiple objects, cropped, hands, table

hood.name: hood
hood.subject: An empty hooded cloak hood in moss green clay: a deep, softly peaked hood with a wide rounded face opening, and a short draped shoulder cape attached at its base, thick heavy folds, no clasp, no buttons, no laces.

dark_shades.name: dark shades
dark_shades.subject: A pair of chunky dark sunglasses in matte near-black clay: one thick rounded-rectangle frame with two big opaque matte black lenses, a thick bridge, and two short thick temple arms folded open. Wide and bold, like a secret agent's shades.

top_hat.name: top hat
top_hat.subject: A tall top hat in rich purple clay: a straight tall crown slightly wider at the top, a flat top, a thick band near the base, and a wide brim curled up at both sides. Chunky and theatrical.

bob_wig.name: bob wig
bob_wig.subject: A chin-length bob wig in chestnut brown clay, sculpted as one smooth solid mass with no separate strands: a rounded dome top, a straight thick fringe across the front, and sides that curve under at the bottom, with an open hollow face opening at the front.

ball_cap.name: ball cap
ball_cap.subject: A plain baseball cap in cherry red clay: a rounded six-panel crown with a round button on top and a thick curved peak at the front. Plain, no logo, no patch.

wide_brim_hat.name: wide-brim hat
wide_brim_hat.subject: A wide-brim field hat in straw-yellow clay: a rounded, dented crown with a thick band, and a very wide floppy brim that dips a little at the front and back, like a farm hat or an explorer's hat. Smooth clay, no woven texture.

saucepan_helmet.name: saucepan helmet
saucepan_helmet.subject: A silly homemade costume helmet in matte black clay: a short round cooking pot turned upside down so its flat round bottom is on top and its open mouth faces down, a thick rolled rim around the bottom edge, and one long thick straight pan handle sticking out horizontally from the rim to the side. Shaped like a dome helmet, not a real film helmet.
saucepan_helmet.subject_round1: A homemade helmet made from an upside-down saucepan in matte black clay: a round deep pot turned bottom-up, with a thick rolled rim, and a long thick straight handle sticking out to one side. A silly costume helmet, not a real film helmet.
saucepan_helmet.extra_negative: frying pan, skillet, lid, knob, plunger, upright pot, open top

wizard_hat.name: wizard hat
wizard_hat.subject: A tall wizard hat in dusty gray clay: a tall soft cone whose tip flops over to one side, a thick band at its base, and a wide, slightly wavy round brim. No stars, no moons, no patterns.

tiara.name: tiara
tiara.subject: A chunky tiara in pale silver-white clay: a thick curved headband with three big rounded points rising at the front, the middle point tallest, each point topped with a big round smooth bead. Bold and simple, no small gems, no filigree.

fedora.name: fedora
fedora.subject: A classic fedora in dark charcoal gray clay: a crown with a deep pinch at the front and a long crease along the top, a thick band, and a medium brim snapped down at the front and up at the back.

horned_helmet_beard.name: horned helmet with beard
horned_helmet_beard.subject: An empty dwarf costume set in clay, front view: a round iron-gray helmet with a thick rim and two big curved horns, and a huge bushy ginger beard sculpted as one solid rounded mass, joined to the helmet by thick gray straps down both sides. Between the helmet rim and the top of the beard there is a big empty hole, and the plain gray background shows through it. Nothing inside the hole.
horned_helmet_beard.subject_round1: A dwarf costume piece in clay: a round iron-gray helmet with a thick rim and two big curved horns, joined at both sides by thick cheek straps to a huge bushy ginger beard sculpted as one solid rounded mass, with a wide empty gap between the helmet rim and the beard where a face would show.
horned_helmet_beard.extra_negative: nose, eyes, ears, skin, cheeks, face, mouth, head inside

dino_hood.name: dino hood
dino_hood.subject: A dinosaur costume hood in grass green clay: a big friendly cartoon dinosaur head with its jaws wide open, a row of big rounded white teeth on the upper and lower jaw, two round eyes on top, small rounded spikes down the back, and a wide empty opening inside the open mouth where a face would look out. Cute, not scary.

beanie.name: beanie
beanie.subject: A snug knit beanie in gray-blue clay: a short rounded dome with a thick folded cuff at the bottom and a few broad vertical ribs, and one big round pompom on top. Short and round, not tall.
